text:
I RACED USAIN BOLT!
There has never been a more important episode or challenge for Speed.  His entirety identity is built on one thing–SPEED. But there is a big difference between being fast on YouTube and being a world-class sprinter. Speed is determined to prove that he has what it takes to be the latter.  And there is simply no better person in the history of the world to coach and judge him than the fastest man in the history of the world…Usain Bolt. Can Speed convince Usain that he is worthy of his name?
